messages:
harper: deploybot flagged an anomaly: quant-v5b + runtime 2.18 in ap-southeast-1 has nondeterministic KV rotation failures on sessions >4096. suggest regional soft-pin + float fallback while we triage. :eyes:
deploybot: ALERT: incompatibility detected for model 'quant-v5b' with runtime '2.18' in ap-southeast-1. Observed: intermittent kvcache rotation mismatch (2.9% of longseq runs). Recommended action: apply regional soft-pin to runtime:2.17 and route new sessions to f32 fallback.
mina: can someone paste the failing trace? need to confirm if it's eviction order or an off-by-one window.
derek: snippet from the repro harness attached to logs:
```
[2026-06-05T03:21:10Z] node-11 runtime-2.18 kernel: kvcache rotation mismatch shard=9 expected_seq=24576 got=24560
[2026-06-05T03:21:10Z] model quant-v5b: attention_state checksum mismatch
```
zane: sdk checks look clean. this smells like a scheduler preemption case when async rotation coincides with quant decode window.
sre-oncall: routing to float fallback will raise 95p latency in APAC by ~50ms; also increases token-cost ~1.8x. I'll create alerts for error rate and latency before we switch.
harper: propose plan: 1) regional soft-pin 12h (ap-southeast-1) 2) route new sessions to f32-fallback only (no mid-session migration) 3) eng-runtime + eng-ml to reproduce and pair on kernel semaphore patch 4) test fix in eu-canary and lift pin when green. any objections?
mina: +1 regional only. also request that deploybot set auto-unpin TTL and an owner.
deploybot: EXEC: pin add --scope region --region ap-southeast-1 --target runtime:2.17 --model quant-v5b --mode soft --ttl 12h --owner harper --reason "kvcache rotation mismatch on longseq"
deploybot: Pin applied -> pin_id=pin_4599999999. New sessions in ap-southeast-1 will prefer runtime:2.17 for quant-v5b. Auto-unpin in 12h unless extended. Audit: user=harper.
derek: i'll spin up a tight longseq harness with deterministic seeds and instrument kernel rotations. planning to repro within 2h.
zane: i'll pre-warm a small f32 pool and add autoscale runway. ETA 25m. note: if traffic spikes we'll need to extend the pool.
product: draft a short changelog line and optional customer FYI if pin >24h: "APAC: temporary routing to float variant for quant-v5b to ensure correctness on long sequences; regional soft-pin applied." support, please prep canned replies.
support: acknowledged. prepping template: "We are routing APAC requests to a float-compatible variant for quant-v5b to ensure correctness on long contexts. No action required from customers; we expect normal latency impacts."
sre-oncall: added temporary alerts: ap-southeast-1 quant-v5b longseq errors >0.8% for 5m -> pager; 95p latency >180ms -> pager. Also added a cost spike alert for token-cost >2x baseline.
harper: set an explicit rollback plan: if f32 fallback fails or error spikes >2% after routing for 10m, revert the pin and roll to runtime 2.17 region-wide (manual), then engage exec. Derek, please summarize reproducibility status in this thread so product/support can update customers.
derek: will post repro status in-loop. if deterministic, we'll push a kernel semaphore patch to ci-canary in ~3h and test.
mina: request logging improvement: add KV rotation sequence logging at debug level for next 6 hours in ap-southeast-1 for quant-v5b to help root cause. ops, can we enable?
sre-oncall: enabled debug-level KV rotation traces for quant-v5b in ap-southeast-1 for 6h. watchers added to the rotation metric dashboard.
harper: thanks everyone. logging action items in release-tracker and will update once we have repro or decide to extend TTL. please @mention here for any escalations. :white_check_mark:
